style.backgroundSystem: only three fields are allowed across the set: a real nordic living-room interior (matte off-white plaster wall #F4F2ED with one low painted moulded rail, pale plank floor #DCD5CB, sheer curtain at one edge), a seamless warm paper studio field #F4F2ED or pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and spec screens, and one flat mist-blue graphic band #6E8494 for process and trust layouts; one clean copy zone per screen, never busy decor
style.direction: quiet nordic whole-room soft-furnishing commerce, airy daylight interior rather than dark material editorial
style.iconSystem: 1.5px monoline pictograms plus small filled square number chips 01-06 in #6E8494 with #F4F2ED numerals, simple geometric shapes, maximum six per screen, no filled illustration, no 3D badges, no gradient seals
style.lightingSystem: soft diffused north-facing daylight at 6500-7000K entering from a declared off-frame window side, wide gentle falloff, one long soft shadow under the seating only, no hard speculars and no hotspots; evening closing screen may add a single 2700K practical lamp while all other screens stay daylight-only; every piece sits on a visible contact shadow
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent quiet nordic whole-room soft-furnishing visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of off-white plaster #F4F2ED, mist blue #6E8494, warm pale grey upholstery #D9D6CE and one mustard accent #D8B25C; cool daylight grade; one light modern geometric sans-serif family with all Chinese copy wrapped in 「」 and kept short; backgrounds limited to a real nordic living-room interior with one low painted moulded rail and a pale plank floor #DCD5CB, a seamless warm paper studio field, and one flat mist-blue graphic band #6E8494 for process and trust layouts, each screen holding one clean copy zone; lighting always soft diffused north daylight at 6500-7000K from a declared off-frame window side with wide gentle falloff, one long soft shadow under the seating, no hard speculars, every object grounded by a visible contact shadow; surface system of matte plaster, pale plank floor, matte low-pile rug and matte woven fabric rendered exactly as supplied; layout system of generous top or left copy margin, 1px hairline leader lines, small filled square number chips 01-06 in #6E8494 and at most six 1.5px monoline pictograms; product presentation rules: identical scale, arm profile, cushion count and slim leg form in every frame, seated on the floor with contact shadow, corrected straight verticals, a real furnishing as scale anchor, the 3/4 daylight seating angle reused across scene screens; no color palette changes, no recoloured upholstery, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no dark moody grading, no invented dimensions, grades, eco ratings or certificates, no brand marks, no QR codes, no membership badges.
noDrift: no recoloured or re-woven upholstery, no vinyl or leather look
no inconsistent lighting direction or contradictory shadow lengths
no mismatched icon or number-chip styles
no cozy yellowed lifestyle filter and no dark moody material grading
no invented dimensions, fabric grades, eco ratings, board specifications, warranty terms or certificates
no brand mark, no QR code, no membership or free-gift corner badge, no price
style.presentationRules: the sofa keeps one proportional scale, the same arm profile, the same cushion count and the same slim leg form in every frame; it stands on the floor with a real contact shadow and never floats; interior verticals and floor lines stay straight and corrected; a real furnishing (rug, console, coffee table or plant on a stand) always anchors human scale; the 3/4 daylight seating angle used on the opening screen is reused on the closing screen so the set reads as one room
style.surfaceSystem: matte plaster wall, pale wide plank floor #DCD5CB with a visible skirting line, matte low-pile rug #E4E2DC, honed ceramic and matte painted metal accents; upholstery stays matte woven fabric exactly as supplied, never gloss or vinyl sheen
style.typography: one light modern geometric sans-serif family only; Chinese in-image copy always wrapped in 「」 and kept short, headline 26-32pt, kicker 12-14pt, labels 10-12pt; generous top or left margin reserved for copy, no dense body text
